verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents itself as an open-model inference provider. Its docs say developers can call open models through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a 'Choose a model' page lists each model's context, regions and per-tier price, so a first-party catalog of open models on hosted API endpoints exists. The evidence never names any model family or shows how broad the catalog is. Missing for 10: named families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS), evidence of catalog breadth and currency, explicit confirmation of shared serverless endpoints, and independent corroboration.
